tickets.title: pro and flow are optional roles
tickets.what: Owner 2026-11-22: `pro` (web ChatGPT/Gemini/AI Studio) and `flow` (Google Flow images/video) leave the default roster and become optional roles: shipped but off until the owner turns them on (hud setup, Control, or a role file in $HUD_HOME/roles). Off roles are absent from hud_roster and refused by hud_create with a hint naming how to turn them on. Existing owner role files that define them keep working. Spec §2.1.2 sentence on pro changes (draft; the main session tells the owner).

acceptance.text: A fresh HUD_HOME roster lists no pro or flow; turning one on lists it and hud_create works
hud_create role pro when off returns a clear hint

comments.author: legacy
comments.text: The fixture check passed. The full `npm test` run had three timeout cancellations; all three passed in an isolated serial rerun.
